text:
Maria (Support): heads-up: Acme is seeing a ton of embed-ingest rejects since last night after we rolled the schema migration. They're getting `vector_dim_mismatch` in the indexer and customer is pretty upset (latency + failed inserts). Can eng take a look? @Jon K

Jon K (Eng Platform): looking now — any repro request id or sample payload?

Maria (Support): sample error from the gateway logs below, and an example payload from their SDK attached. They also report a billing spike from repeated retries.

Maria (Support): ERROR log: `indexer: insert failed: vector_dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=1535 index=acme_prod_vectors request_id=req_8a3`
Maria (Support): sample curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-xl","input":"hello world","user_id":"acme-123","trace_id":"req_8a3"}'
```
But their downstream indexer shows vector length 1535.

Lee M (ML Infra): quick hypothesis: we swapped to a trimmed-quantized variant of embed-xl in the model catalog yesterday that emits 1535-length vectors for some pipelines (bug). The indexer still expects 1536. I saw a config change in the catalog PR last night: `catalog/pr/842` — may be the root cause.

Samir (Oncall): for immediate mitigation we can do two things:
- change indexer to accept variable dims (temporary) or
- route Acme to the previous model variant (1536) via routing override until backfill completes
Either one will stop the customer-facing errors. Which is easier?

Jon K (Eng Platform): routing override is less risky. I can pin them to `embed-xl@v1.9` for their org. Samir: how to flip indexer variable-dim temporarily?

Samir (Oncall): run this on the indexer config pod; it's a hot-reload env toggle:
```
kubectl -n indexer exec -it deploy/indexer -- sh -c "export INDEXER_ALLOW_VARIABLE_DIM=true && kill -SIGHUP 1"
```
That will make the indexer accept and pad/trim vectors. Note: padding strategy pads with zeros to the highest seen dim; it will affect retrieval quality slightly.

Lee M (ML Infra): padding could affect nearest-neighbor scores. Prefer routing override + backfill of the ~3M docs for Acme to the 1535 vectors if the model change is permanent. If the change was accidental, revert the catalog entry.

Maria (Support): customer wants a root-cause & a credit for the retry billing — they estimate ~1200 failed inserts -> billing spike. Please confirm.

Billing Bot: Ticket SUP-4321 created; provisional credit queued for review.

Jon K (Eng Platform): I'll pin Acme to the old variant right now and notify support. Then we should schedule a backfill. Steps I'm going to take:
1) apply org-level routing override for acme-123 -> `embed-xl@v1.9` (done)
2) open a backfill run for acme vectors using the `backfill-tool` (pending approvals)
3) follow-up with product/ML on whether the 1535 dim is intended
PR reference for routing change: https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/842

Lee M (ML Infra): backfill command (dry-run first):
```
./tools/backfill --org acme-123 --source emb-api --model embed-xl@v2 --target-dim 1536 --dry-run
```
If we're converting from 1535->1536 we should use the convert script that pads vectors deterministically, then re-ingest. If the change is intentional and we want to keep 1535, then indexer schema must be migrated and all existing docs re-encoded with the new model.

Samir (Oncall): quick repro to simulate the error locally:
```
# produce a 1535-vector (slice off one value) and send to indexer
python -c "import requests, json; v=[0.1]*1535; payload={'id':'x1','vector':v}; r=requests.post('https://indexer.internal/ingest', json=payload); print(r.text)"
# expect: {"error":"vector_dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=1535"}
```
That helped me reproduce in staging.

Maria (Support): customer update: "thank you for the quick fix — retries stopped after pinning. Please let us know ETA for full fix/backfill."

Jon K (Eng Platform): ETA: routing pin applied (done). Backfill queued; depends on approval from infra (to allocate batch capacity) and ML sign-off on conversion strategy. Tentative start tomorrow 04:00 UTC; duration ~3-6 hours for Acme dataset. I added this to SUP-4321.

Lee M (ML Infra): root cause: unintended model variant swap in catalog PR (missing dimension sanity check). I'll add a preflight check to the model ingestion pipeline that verifies embedding dims across variants and blocks catalog activation if dims differ more than 0. Filing PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4213

Action items:
- Lee: merge dimension-check preflight (PR 4213)
- Jon: run backfill or conversion depending on ML decision (blocked on infra quota)
- Samir: prepare short rollback/playbook to flip indexer toggle if something goes wrong
- Maria: keep customer updated and track credits via SUP-4321

Maria (Support): thanks all — closing loop after backfill finishes. :thumbsup:

Samir (Oncall): adding a short-runbook to sup ticket with the commands above and the hotfix toggle.

Jon K (Eng Platform): will post final postmortem once PRs and backfill complete.

(DeployBot): catalog/pr/842 was reverted by Jon K at 2026-03-10T03:12:14Z

Maria (Support): noted. Follow-up - do we want a customer-facing RCA or just a summary?

Lee M (ML Infra): send a brief RCA with root cause + mitigation + timeline. Avoid internal details about internal toggles. Include assurance: dim preflight now added.

Maria (Support): will draft and send to Acme, CC-ing billing.
